summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Principal Equity Premium Income ETF (PCOV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in dividend-paying, large- and mid-cap value stocks while using covered call options to generate income. The fund seeks current income and the potential for capital appreciation. PCOV was launched on Aug 18, 2026 and is issued by Principal.

holdings.infoBox: PCOV is an equity ETF with a total of 96 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 5.32%, Microsoft at 4.20%, JPMorgan Chase & Co. at 4.01%, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 3.36%, and Costco Wholesale at 3.06%.
